content:
carmen: quick heads-up — PR #3421 (docs: routing migration guide + SDK snippet) needs merge timing aligned with the 0.10 rollout. It's behind feature flag `new-routing`. We need reviewers and a merge slot that doesn't collide with the canary deploy. /cc @alice @ben

alice: I'll shepherd reviews. Can someone post the docs-preview link? Also is this change versioned under /docs/0.10/ or main?

ben: I can review later today. CI is failing on the site build tho: https://ci.redwood/proj/123/build/456 — failing lighthouse check for CSS import; working on a fix.

carmen: docs-preview is up: https://deploy-preview-3421--docs.redwood.ai — note the TOC change. We're targeting the scheduled release window on 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC. If the FF is toggled later, docs should be behind versioned path /v0.10/intro.

alice: ACK. I'll do a content pass and ping design for the screenshots. @ben once CI green we need 2 approvals: docs + eng. Can we merge inside the release window (hold if SRE needs rollback)?

ben: CI fixed, pushed patch. All green now. https://ci.redwood/proj/123/build/456 — ready for review.

alice: LGTM with one nit (SDK snippet uses old client init). Suggest replace with:

```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
# use client.generate(...)
```

alice: Also add a note under 'behavior behind feature flag' and a short migration step for users moving from /v0.9/.

carmen: Good catch. @dave can we reserve merge slot 18:00-18:15 UTC for this change? We want the docs to go live right after the canary flips.

dave: Yes, reserving 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC. If anything blocks, hit me in #release-war-room. Also make sure to add the FF rollout tag in the PR body `ff:new-routing=true`.

docs-bot: PR 3421 status changed: REVIEW_REQUIRED -> APPROVED by alice, ben

alice: approved, leaving the merge to release window. :thumbsup:

ben: tagged PR with `ff:new-routing=true` and added migration anchor. merging blocked until 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC per @dave

frank: FYI SRE will watch canary metrics, ping if traffic spike. If rollback needed, re-open PR and revert docs commit.

carmen: thanks team. After merge, please file a one-liner in release notes: 'Docs: Migration guide + SDK snippet for new-routing (behind ff)'.

alice: done.
